approved_by: the repository owner, by approving and merging the pull request that adds this file
reason: Claude Code left output counts unfinalized for every request but the last in each subagent transcript, and some sessions billed a side request that no transcript records. Filing metered these attempts as complete. Their filed costs and output counts are therefore lower bounds.
rule: Each attempt below was filed with metering_status complete and re-meters incomplete with the current meter at the filed rates. The re-metered cost equals the filed cost for every one. The explorer exports its filed cost as a lower bound and its output tokens as unknown. Attempt records, usage requests and transcripts are unchanged.

causes.unfinalized-requests: A transcript request has no stop reason, so its recorded output count is partial and the session totals repeat the partial count.
causes.unrecorded-side-request: The session totals bill a request, a small claude-haiku-4-5 call, that no transcript records.

method: docs/research/builtin-output-undercount-2026-10-21/remeter.py, then tabulate.py; the full table is docs/research/builtin-output-undercount-2026-10-21/remeter.tsv
